overview.name: GSR Crypto Core3 ETF
overview.description: The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of borrowings for investment purposes) in three of the most established (or "core") crypto currencies—Bitcoin (“BTC”), Ethereum (“ETH”), and Solana. It manages its portfolio such that no more than 15% of net assets are considered illiquid, consistent with Rule 22e-4 under the 1940 Act, and all staking activities engaged in by the fund are subject to this limitation. The fund is non-diversified.
